settings_graphics_autoscroll_description: Automatically scroll hand cards when pointer or cursor hovers near edges.
settings_graphics_mat_ripple_description: Colour changes sweep across the mat in a pixel wave.
settings_graphics_ambient_dust_descripti: Tiny dust motes drift around the table.

lobby_mode_race_desc: The first players to empty their hand win. Once enough have finished, everyone else loses.
lobby_settings_race_percent_desc: Share of the seats that win. The match ends once that many players have emptied their hand.
glossary_race_desc: The first players to empty their hand win. The match ends once enough have finished, and everyone else loses.
error_spectator_cannot_act: Spectators cannot perform actions during the match
settings_censor_text_description: Masks swear words in chat, names and lobby titles. Turn off to see text exactly as written.
glossary_draw_desc: Take one or more cards from the [k=vanilla:draw_pile]draw pile[/k] into your hand.
glossary_skip_desc: Causes the next player in [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k] order to lose their turn.
glossary_reverse_desc: Reverses the direction of play. In a 2-player match, acts as a [k=vanilla:skip]skip[/k].
glossary_wild_desc: Can be played on any card. The player chooses the active [k=vanilla:color]color[/k].
glossary_turn_desc: A player's opportunity to [k=vanilla:play]play[/k] a valid card or [k=vanilla:draw]draw[/k].
glossary_color_desc: The active suit (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow) that determines valid plays.
glossary_draw_pile_desc: The central deck where players [k=vanilla:draw]draw[/k] cards when unable or choosing not to play.
glossary_discard_pile_desc: The pile where played cards are placed face-up.
glossary_play_desc: Place a matching card from your hand onto the [k=vanilla:discard_pile]discard pile[/k].
glossary_seven_zero_desc: Playing a 7 allows swapping hands with any player. Playing a 0 rotates all hands in [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k] direction.
glossary_draw_stacking_desc: Stack +2 or +4 cards to pass the accumulated [k=vanilla:draw]draw[/k] penalty to the next player.
glossary_force_play_desc: When drawing a playable card from the deck, you must play it immediately.
glossary_jump_in_desc: Play out of turn if you have the exact identical card (same color and value) as the top card.
glossary_progressive_desc: Cards that match the top card's value can be chained together in the same [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k].
card_desc_skip: Causes the next player in [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k] order to be [k=vanilla:skip]skipped[/k].
card_desc_reverse: [k=vanilla:reverse]Reverses[/k] the direction of [k=vanilla:play]play[/k]. In 2-player games, acts as a [k=vanilla:skip]skip[/k].
card_desc_draw2: Forces the next player to [k=vanilla:draw]draw[/k] 2 cards from the [k=vanilla:draw_pile]draw pile[/k] and [k=vanilla:skip]skip[/k] their [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k].
card_desc_wild: A [k=vanilla:wild]wild[/k] card that can be played on any card. Choose the active [k=vanilla:color]color[/k].
card_desc_wild_draw4: Choose the active [k=vanilla:color]color[/k]. The next player must [k=vanilla:draw]draw[/k] 4 cards and [k=vanilla:skip]skip[/k] their [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k].
card_desc_number: Number card. Match by [k=vanilla:color]color[/k] or number to [k=vanilla:play]play[/k] onto the [k=vanilla:discard_pile]discard pile[/k].
card_desc_seven: Number card 7. If the [k=vanilla:seven_zero]7-0[/k] rule is active, swap hands with any player.
card_desc_zero: Number card 0. If the [k=vanilla:seven_zero]7-0[/k] rule is active, rotates all hands in [k=vanilla:turn]turn[/k] direction.
